Named holds retained open: SE-GOTLAND-TIER (keep municipal SE-K0980-C), SE-EP-SAM-TIER (other), SE-2026-COUNT-IN-PROGRESS (310 local preliminary refresh), SE-HISTORICAL-BOUNDARIES, SE-HISTORIC-PARTY-DETAIL, SE-REPEAT-AND-RECOUNT, SE-FARGELANDA-1973. importer_policy.note: No Sweden Atlas importer in this landing. A future separately authorized importer may load all 320 accepted offices. Named holds stay open.
